mapper.select: SELECT #{businessDate} AS business_date, company.company_id, employee.employee_id, employee_version.employee_version_id, employee_version.row_version AS employee_version, employment.employment_period_id, employment.assignment_id AS employment_assignment_id, employment.row_version AS employment_version, employment.organization_id, attendance_assignment.attendance_group_assignment_id, attendance_assignment.snapshot_digest AS assignment_snapshot_digest, attendance_group.attendance_group_id, group_revision.attendance_group_revision_id, group_revision.snapshot_digest AS group_snapshot_digest, location.location_id, location_revision.location_revision_id, location_revision.time_zone AS location_time_zone, location_revision.snapshot_digest AS location_snapshot_digest, work_calendar.work_calendar_id, calendar_version.work_calendar_version_id, calendar_version.time_zone_snapshot AS calendar_time_zone, calendar_version.snapshot_digest AS calendar_snapshot_digest, calendar_day.work_calendar_day_id, calendar_day.day_type, calendar_day.snapshot_digest AS calendar_day_snapshot_digest, group_revision.shift_template_id AS group_shift_template_id, effective_shift_template.shift_template_id, effective_shift.shift_version_id, effective_shift.time_zone_snapshot AS shift_time_zone, effective_shift.snapshot_digest AS shift_snapshot_digest FROM company company JOIN employee employee ON employee.company_id = company.company_id AND employee.employee_id = #{employeeId} JOIN employee_version employee_version ON employee_version.employee_id = employee.employee_id AND employee_version.status = 'ACTIVE' AND employee_version.effective_from <= #{businessDate} AND ( employee_version.effective_to IS NULL OR employee_version.effective_to > #{businessDate} ) AND employee_version.created_at <= #{knowledgeAsOf} JOIN employment_assignment employment ON employment.employee_id = employee.employee_id AND employment.version_valid_to IS NULL AND employment.record_status = 'ACTIVE' AND DATE(employment.effective_from) <= #{businessDate} AND ( employment.effective_to IS NULL OR DATE(employment.effective_to) > #{businessDate} ) AND employment.created_at <= #{knowledgeAsOf} JOIN organization_identity organization ON organization.organization_id = employment.organization_id AND organization.company_id = company.company_id AND organization.identity_status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN attendance_group_assignment attendance_assignment ON attendance_assignment.employee_id = employee.employee_id AND attendance_assignment.effective_from <= #{businessDate} AND attendance_assignment.created_at <= #{knowledgeAsOf} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance_group_assignment successor WHERE successor.supersedes_assignment_id = attendance_assignment.attendance_group_assignment_id AND successor.effective_from <= #{businessDate} AND successor.created_at <= #{knowledgeAsOf} ) JOIN attendance_assignment_timeline assignment_timeline ON assignment_timeline.attendance_group_assignment_id = attendance_assignment.attendance_group_assignment_id AND assignment_timeline.employee_id = employee.employee_id AND assignment_timeline.state = 'ACTIVE' AND assignment_timeline.business_effective_from <= #{businessDate} AND assignment_timeline.recorded_at <= #{knowledgeAsOf} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance_assignment_timeline newer_assignment WHERE newer_assignment.attendance_group_assignment_id = assignment_timeline.attendance_group_assignment_id AND newer_assignment.business_effective_from <= #{businessDate} AND newer_assignment.recorded_at <= #{knowledgeAsOf} AND newer_assignment.event_sequence > assignment_timeline.event_sequence ) JOIN attendance_group_revision group_revision ON group_revision.attendance_group_revision_id = attendance_assignment.attendance_group_revision_id JOIN attendance_group attendance_group ON attendance_group.attendance_group_id = group_revision.attendance_group_id AND attendance_group.company_id = company.company_id JOIN attendance_group_timeline group_timeline ON group_timeline.attendance_group_id = attendance_group.attendance_group_id AND group_timeline.attendance_group_revision_id = group_revision.attendance_group_revision_id AND group_timeline.state = 'ACTIVE' AND group_timeline.business_effective_from <= #{businessDate} AND group_timeline.recorded_at <= #{knowledgeAsOf} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attendance_group_timeline newer_group WHERE newer_group.attendance_group_id = group_timeline.attendance_group_id AND newer_group.business_effective_from <= #{businessDate} AND newer_group.recorded_at <= #{knowledgeAsOf} AND newer_group.event_sequence > group_timeline.event_sequence ) JOIN location_revision location_revision ON location_revision.location_revision_id = group_revision.location_revision_id JOIN location location ON location.location_id = location_revision.location_id AND location.company_id = company.company_id JOIN location_timeline location_timeline ON location_timeline.location_id = location.location_id AND location_timeline.location_revision_id = location_revision.location_revision_id AND location_timeline.state = 'ACTIVE' AND location_timeline.business_effective_from <= #{businessDate} AND location_timeline.recorded_at <= #{knowledgeAsOf} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM location_timeline newer_location WHERE newer_location.location_id = location_timeline.location_id AND newer_location.business_effective_from <= #{businessDate} AND newer_location.recorded_at <= #{knowledgeAsOf} AND newer_location.event_sequence > location_timeline.event_sequence ) JOIN work_calendar work_calendar ON work_calendar.work_calendar_id = group_revision.work_calendar_id AND work_calendar.company_id = company.company_id AND work_calendar.location_id = location.location_id JOIN calendar_publication_timeline calendar_publication ON calendar_publication.work_calendar_id = work_calendar.work_calendar_id AND calendar_publication.state = 'PUBLISHED' AND calendar_publication.business_effective_from <= #{businessDate} AND calendar_publication.recorded_at <= #{knowledgeAsOf} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM calendar_publication_timeline newer_calendar WHERE newer_calendar.work_calendar_id = calendar_publication.work_calendar_id AND newer_calendar.business_effective_from <= #{businessDate} AND newer_calendar.recorded_at <= #{knowledgeAsOf} AND ( newer_calendar.business_effective_from > calendar_publication.business_effective_from OR ( newer_calendar.business_effective_from = calendar_publication.business_effective_from AND newer_calendar.event_sequence > calendar_publication.event_sequence ) ) ) JOIN work_calendar_version calendar_version ON calendar_version.work_calendar_version_id = calendar_publication.work_calendar_version_id AND calendar_version.work_calendar_id = work_calendar.work_calendar_id AND calendar_version.effective_from <= #{businessDate} AND calendar_version.effective_to > #{businessDate} JOIN work_calendar_day calendar_day ON calendar_day.work_calendar_version_id = calendar_version.work_calendar_version_id AND calendar_day.business_date = #{businessDate} AND calendar_day.created_at <= #{knowledgeAsOf} JOIN shift_version effective_shift ON ( ( calendar_day.shift_version_override_id IS NULL AND effective_shift.shift_template_id = group_revision.shift_template_id ) OR effective_shift.shift_version_id = calendar_day.shift_version_override_id ) AND effective_shift.effective_from <= #{businessDate} AND effective_shift.created_at <= #{knowledgeAsOf} JOIN shift_template effective_shift_template ON effective_shift_template.shift_template_id = effective_shift.shift_template_id AND effective_shift_template.company_id = company.company_id AND effective_shift_template.location_id = location.location_id JOIN shift_publication_timeline shift_publication ON shift_publication.shift_template_id = effective_shift.shift_template_id AND shift_publication.shift_version_id = effective_shift.shift_version_id AND shift_publication.state = 'PUBLISHED' AND shift_publication.business_effective_from <= #{businessDate} AND shift_publication.recorded_at <= #{knowledgeAsOf} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM shift_publication_timeline newer_shift WHERE newer_shift.shift_template_id = shift_publication.shift_template_id AND newer_shift.business_effective_from <= #{businessDate} AND newer_shift.recorded_at <= #{knowledgeAsOf} AND ( newer_shift.business_effective_from > shift_publication.business_effective_from OR ( newer_shift.business_effective_from = shift_publication.business_effective_from AND newer_shift.event_sequence > shift_publication.event_sequence ) ) ) JOIN shift_template group_shift_template ON group_shift_template.shift_template_id = group_revision.shift_template_id AND group_shift_template.company_id = company.company_id AND group_shift_template.location_id = location.location_id WHERE company.company_id = #{companyId} AND company.status = 'ACTIVE' AND location_revision.time_zone = calendar_version.time_zone_snapshot AND location_revision.time_zone = effective_shift.time_zone_snapshot AND COALESCE( ( SELECT latest_group_template.action_code FROM audit_event latest_group_template WHERE latest_group_template.resource_type = 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE' AND latest_group_template.resource_id_ref = group_shift_template.shift_template_id AND latest_group_template.action_code IN ( 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_ACTIVE', 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_INACTIVE' ) AND latest_group_template.occurred_at <= #{knowledgeAsOf} ORDER BY CASE WHEN latest_group_template.policy_version IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC, CAST(COALESCE( latest_group_template.policy_version, '0') AS DECIMAL(20, 0)) DESC, latest_group_template.occurred_at DESC, latest_group_template.event_id DESC LIMIT 1 ), 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_ACTIVE' ) <> 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_INACTIVE' AND COALESCE( ( SELECT latest_effective_template.action_code FROM audit_event latest_effective_template WHERE latest_effective_template.resource_type = 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE' AND latest_effective_template.resource_id_ref = effective_shift_template.shift_template_id AND latest_effective_template.action_code IN ( 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_ACTIVE', 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_INACTIVE' ) AND latest_effective_template.occurred_at <= #{knowledgeAsOf} ORDER BY CASE WHEN latest_effective_template.policy_version IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END DESC, CAST(COALESCE( latest_effective_template.policy_version, '0') AS DECIMAL(20, 0)) DESC, latest_effective_template.occurred_at DESC, latest_effective_template.event_id DESC LIMIT 1 ), 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_ACTIVE' ) <> 'SHIFT_TEMPLATE_INACTIVE' ORDER BY employee_version.employee_version_id, employment.assignment_id, attendance_assignment.attendance_group_assignment_id, group_revision.attendance_group_revision_id, location_revision.location_revision_id, calendar_version.work_calendar_version_id, effective_shift.shift_version_id LIMIT 2 FOR SHARE
